title: Partnership Commitments
description: The three-commitment list with its photo and floating caption.

intro.default: Every student gets one chance. One. Everything we do exists to help school leaders make it worth it. The true measure of our work is not what we did. It is what changed because of it.

item1Body.default: Your educators know their schools best. We take the time to understand your strengths, challenges, and goals before recommending a path forward.

item2Body.default: We're not here to hand you a plan and walk away. We collaborate with school and district leaders, providing coaching, guidance, and support throughout the work.

item3Body.default: Our goal is to build the confidence, leadership, and internal capacity that allow educators to continue the work long after our partnership ends.

imageAlt.default: District and school leaders working together during a Focused Schools leadership retreat.
